caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser consisting of four drawers, arranged in two horizontal rows and two vertical columns. Each drawer has a round knob handle located in its center. The dresser is colored in shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns rendered on its surfaces, suggesting a natural wood material. The furniture piece has a rectangular top and straight sides, with a simple molded edge along the top. The lower part features bracket-style feet with curved cutouts at the corners, and all four feet are flush with the outer edges of the dresser. The background is plain and a light cream color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present in the drawing. On the lower right side of the background, the words "Jose Rivero" are handwritten in small, neat letters.
